question: The Indian Air Force (IAF) contingent returned to India on 10 August 2024 after participating in Exercise ___________ in Malaysia.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Udara Shakti**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A contingent of the Indian Air Force (IAF) left for Malaysia on 12 August 2022 to participate in a bilateral exercise named 'Udarashakti'.
 
• This is the first bilateral exercise being conducted between Indian Air Force and Royal Malaysian Air Force (RMAF).
 
• IAF is participating in the exercise with Su-30 MKI and C-17 aircraft while the RMAF will be flying Su 30 MKM aircraft.
 
• **The exercise was held from August 5–9, 2024 in Kuantan, Malaysia.**
 
• **The exercise's main goal is to improve military cooperation, mutual understanding, and operational expertise sharing.**
 
• **The IAF contingent was led by Group Captain Ajay Rathi.**
 
• **The IAF contingent participated with seven Su-30MKI aircraft.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• Malaysia is a country in Southeast Asia.
 
• It's known for its beaches, rainforests and mix of Malay, Chinese, Indian and European cultural influences.

• Prime Minster: Ismail Sabri Yaakob
 
• Capital: Kuala Lumpur (Executive capital), Putrajaya (Administrative capital)
